name: NY-06
label: Safe D

key_factors: Incumbent Grace Meng with strong fundraising and cash advantage
District leans Democratic by about six points
Republican challenger raised only a few thousand dollars
Prediction markets price Democratic win around 95%
model.rationale: Meng is a well-funded incumbent in a Democratic-leaning district, while Joseph Chou has raised under $3,000 and has no outside support, making a competitive race implausible. Markets and fundamentals both point to a comfortable Democratic hold.
model.watch: A surprise outside-spending intervention on Chou's behalf is the only realistic path to narrowing this race.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Grace Meng seeks another term in this Queens-based district that leans Democratic by about six points. She enters the general election with more than $1 million on hand after raising over $2 million, while Republican Joseph Chou has raised roughly $2,600 and reports only about $4,100 in cash. No outside groups are spending against her, and no expert raters flag the seat as competitive.

Prediction markets give Meng roughly a 95% chance of winning, consistent with the district's lean and the lopsided resource gap. With no public polling available, the forecast rests on fundamentals, which all point the same direction: a safe Democratic hold with a margin near twenty points.
